name: Open a sub-account for a member
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, start the 'Open Sub-Account' flow, fill in the product type, nickname and initial deposit, submit the form, and reach the confirmation screen. Then read the confirmation reference number.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to open the sub-account for.

inputs.name: product_type
inputs.description: The sub-account product type (e.g. 'Holiday Club', 'Money Market').

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: A display nickname for the new sub-account.

inputs.name: initial_deposit
inputs.description: Initial deposit in dollars; the app requires at least $5.00.

outputs.name: confirmation_ref
outputs.description: The confirmation reference number shown on the final screen.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist in the core system. A legitimate negative result the caller must handle.
The sub-account form rejected the submitted values (product/nickname/deposit validation).

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation; dismissed via its Continue button.
